stories.title: Die Krankenkassenprämien fürs Jahr 2027 steigen um 5 Prozent. So sieht es in Ihrem Kanton aus

en.title: Health insurance premiums for 2027 rise by 5 percent. Here's what it looks like in your canton
en.summary: Health insurance premiums in Switzerland are increasing by 5 percent for 2027. A family of four will pay approximately 1230 francs monthly, with the highest premiums in Romandy and Ticino regions.

stories.title: Le Conseil fédéral lance la campagne pour rendre l'exportation des armes suisses plus facile

en.title: Federal Council launches campaign to make Swiss weapons exports easier
en.summary: The Federal Council is calling voters to approve a revision to weapons legislation on November 29. The government argues that relaxing rules on Swiss armaments exports is necessary to maintain defense capacity and preserve jobs.

stories.title: A Bienne, la presse bilingue perd son dernier véritable ambassadeur avec la disparition du «Biel Bienne»

en.title: In Bienne, the bilingual press loses its last true ambassador with the disappearance of "Biel Bienne"
en.summary: The bilingual newspaper Biel Bienne, founded in 1978 and distributed free weekly in Bienne, will cease publication by year-end due to financial difficulties, declining advertising revenue, and rising distribution costs.

stories.title: Prämienanstieg in der Schweiz – So stark steigen die Krankenkassenprämien 2027 in Ihrer Gemeinde

en.title: Premium increase in Switzerland – Health insurance premiums rise by this much in 2027 in your municipality
en.summary: Health insurance premiums in Switzerland will increase by an average of 5 percent in 2027, with variations depending on individual municipalities.

stories.title: Jordan Bardella dénonce "une guerre totale" contre le RN, Marine Le Pen menace Mediapart

en.title: Jordan Bardella denounces "total war" against the RN, Marine Le Pen threatens Mediapart
en.summary: The National Rally president claimed the party faces coordinated attacks following a Mediapart investigation alleging antisemitic remarks, impacting the presidential campaign of polling favorite Marine Le Pen.

stories.title: Le Parlement prolonge le taux réduit de TVA pour l'hôtellerie jusqu'en 2031 malgré l'opposition du Conseil fédéral

en.title: Parliament extends reduced VAT rate for hotels until 2031 despite federal government opposition
en.summary: Parliament approved a compromise extending the reduced 3.8% VAT rate for the hospitality sector to 2031, down from the initially proposed 2035, despite federal opposition and annual costs of 300 million to the state.

stories.title: Derrière la vitrine de la dédiabolisation, les casseroles de Jordan Bardella, Marine Le Pen et leurs proches

en.title: Behind the façade of rebranding, the controversies of Jordan Bardella, Marine Le Pen and their associates
en.summary: Mediapart's revelations of antisemitic messages from Jordan Bardella undermine the National Rally's rebranding efforts, as multiple close associates have faced criticism for problematic statements or far-right connections.

stories.title: Le journal bilingue gratuit Biel Bienne cesse de paraître à la fin de l'année

en.title: Bilingual free newspaper Biel Bienne ceases publication at end of year
en.summary: The bilingual free newspaper Biel Bienne will stop publishing on December 31, 2026, with a new weekly bilingual publication planned to launch in January 2027 in collaboration with the city government.

stories.title: Une explosion fait quatre blessés dans un immeuble de Neuchâtel

en.title: Explosion injures four in Neuchâtel building
en.summary: An explosion occurred in a residential building in Neuchâtel on Tuesday, leaving four people injured, including one in critical condition. Authorities established a security perimeter around the affected structure.

stories.title: MELDUNGEN KULTUR - Kultur: Sandro Brotz wechselt vom SRF zum Blick

en.title: CULTURE NEWS - Sandro Brotz switches from SRF to Blick
en.summary: Sandro Brotz is moving from public broadcaster SRF to the Blick media organization.

stories.title: Kulturnews in Kurzform – Spontanbesuch: Greta Thunberg kommt ans Zurich Film Festival

en.title: Culture news in brief – Surprise visit: Greta Thunberg comes to Zurich Film Festival
en.summary: Climate activist Greta Thunberg, 23, will participate in a panel discussion about Western Sahara at the Zurich Film Festival.

stories.title: Une hausse moyenne de 5% pour les primes maladie en Suisse l'an prochain

en.title: Average 5% increase in health insurance premiums in Switzerland next year
en.summary: Health insurance premiums in Switzerland will rise by an average of 5% in 2027, reaching 412 francs per month. Authorities attribute the increase to expanded medical treatments, medical advances, and population aging.

stories.title: Vom Impfstoff-Superstar zum Ärgernis: Die schwierige Suche nach der Zukunft von Biontech

en.title: From vaccine superstar to nuisance: Biontech's difficult search for its future
en.summary: Biontech is closing three German facilities for which it found no buyers and is refocusing entirely on cancer medications. The company faces significant challenges as it pursues this new strategic direction.

stories.title: Der wohl ungewöhnlichste Börsenprospekt der Welt: Anthropic warnt vor dem Ende der Menschheit durch KI

en.title: Probably the world's most unusual stock prospectus: Anthropic warns of humanity's end through AI
en.summary: US tech companies are increasingly highlighting AI risks in public statements, though President Trump dismisses such warnings as fraudulent. Industry observers suggest financial self-interest may motivate these public cautions.

stories.title: Peter Spuhler macht mit der Nachwuchsförderung bei Stadler Rail Ernst. Der neue CEO ist erst 42

en.title: Peter Spuhler takes youth development at Stadler Rail seriously. The new CEO is just 42
en.summary: Stadler Rail's incoming CEO Philipp Brunner, age 42, is regarded as results-oriented in his implementation approach. He will need to adapt to Peter Spuhler's continued prominent role as board president and major shareholder.

stories.title: MELDUNGEN WIRTSCHAFT - Wirtschaftsaussichten für die Schweiz verbessern sich +++ Der Schweizer Zugbauer Stadler Rail erhält einen neuen CEO

en.title: BUSINESS BRIEFS - Economic outlook for Switzerland improving +++ Swiss train manufacturer Stadler Rail appoints new CEO
en.summary: Switzerland's economic outlook is improving. Stadler Rail, a Swiss rail manufacturer, has appointed a new chief executive officer.

stories.title: Lindt & Sprüngli verkauft deutlich weniger Schokolade als erwartet – die Aktie bricht ein

en.title: Lindt & Sprüngli sells significantly less chocolate than expected – stock plummets
en.summary: Lindt & Sprüngli reduced its revenue forecast for the second time this year, citing a hot summer's negative impact on sales, though underlying challenges run deeper.
